methods.joint_delta: 20 normalized hand joint increments plus the common arm interface
methods.pca6: Six posture coordinates fitted on training data only
methods.latent8: Eight learned continuous skill coordinates; temporal horizon matched
methods.fingertip_targets: Palm-frame fingertip displacement goals with common feasibility checking
methods.object_goal: Object pose/twist goals executed by a learned dexterous controller
methods.flat_primitives: Named parameterized contact primitives; no composition contracts
methods.contact_grammar: The same contact primitives with typed roles and transition contracts
methods.grammar_residual: Contact grammar plus a bounded learned residual controller

success_rules.wrench_regrasp: Acquire and reorient in palm, engage fixed fastener, complete calibrated loaded turns and constrained regrasp cycles; no drop or forbidden support
success_rules.nut_finger_spin: Advance initially engaged nut on fixed stud through target angle and axial distance using fingers with bounded wrist rotation; hold final state
success_rules.cable_wrap: Retain specified free end and achieve prescribed wraps around finger group or fixture, with tension, curvature, no-crossing and final-hold constraints

threshold_status: Set numerical tolerances from calibration and freeze before evaluation

common_budget.notes: Proposed pilot settings; freeze before comparison. Match primitive checkpoints exactly for the primary contrast. Track LLM tokens, calls, latency and all low-level training separately.
